entries.deferred_fact: The snapshot-owned state of a production LoadedVm: the decoded SavedState that LoadedVm::save would return, i.e. every registered state unit's save output keyed by unit name plus StateUnits::inventory. No other definition is admissible: the LoadedVm::save contract equates this View with the decoded real save output.
entries.consumer: View for LoadedVm; LoadedVm::restore_snapshot_state, InitializedVm::load, and LoadedVm::save contracts
entries.removal: Define it from the state units' save observations and discharge it together with a verified LoadedVm::save body (currently external_body, temporary).

entries.deferred_fact: Per-unit downtime compensation as observed by the unit's next save: the state its advance_time produces (and, for the partition unit, PartitionUnit::advance_tsc and the backend snapshot clock). Identity for units with the default no-op advance_time.
entries.consumer: VmSnapshotView::after_downtime in the restore and load contracts
entries.removal: Define it per unit from that unit's saved-state schema and advance_time refinement; it is anchored through the LoadedVm::save contract on the restored VM.
